```{=html}
<div class="gfilter" role="group" aria-label="Filter photographs by region">
<button class="gf on" data-r="all">All</button>
<button class="gf" data-r="Florida">Florida</button>
<button class="gf" data-r="Arizona">Arizona</button>
<button class="gf" data-r="Panamá">Panamá</button>
```

```{=html}
<script>
(function () {
  var grid = document.querySelector('.photo-grid');
  var chips = document.querySelectorAll('.gfilter .gf');
  var countEl = document.getElementById('gcount-n');
  if (!grid || !chips.length) return;
  var photos = Array.prototype.slice.call(grid.querySelectorAll('.photo'));
  function apply(region) {
    var n = 0;
    photos.forEach(function (p) {
      var loc = p.getAttribute('data-loc') || '';
      var show = region === 'all' || loc.indexOf(region) !== -1;
      p.style.display = show ? '' : 'none';
      if (show) n++;
    });
    if (countEl) countEl.textContent = n;
  }
  chips.forEach(function (b) {
    b.addEventListener('click', function () {
      chips.forEach(function (x) { x.classList.toggle('on', x === b); });
      apply(b.getAttribute('data-r'));
    });
  });
  apply('all');
})();
</script>
```
